body_template: A severe cyclone is approaching {location}. Conditions are expected to deteriorate from {time}. Wind gusts may exceed {wind_speed}. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: EVACUATE immediately if directed by emergency services. Move to higher ground. Listen to ABC Radio for updates. Call 000 for life-threatening emergencies. Visit {help_url} for evacuation centres.

body_template: A cyclone is approaching {location}. Conditions may deteriorate from {time}. Wind gusts are expected. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: Prepare to evacuate if directed. Secure loose items. Listen to ABC Radio for updates. Call 000 for emergencies. Visit {help_url} for information.

body_template: A dangerous bushfire is threatening {location}. The fire is out of control and poses a serious threat to life. Conditions are expected to worsen from {time}. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: LEAVE NOW if your path is clear. It is too late to stay. Follow your bushfire survival plan. Call 000 for life-threatening emergencies. Visit {help_url} for shelter locations.

body_template: A bushfire is burning near {location}. Conditions may change rapidly from {time}. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: Prepare to leave. Monitor conditions closely. Follow your bushfire survival plan. Call 000 for emergencies. Visit {help_url} for updates.

body_template: Major flooding is occurring or expected at {location}. Water levels are rising rapidly. Flash flooding is possible from {time}. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: EVACUATE low-lying areas immediately. Do NOT enter floodwater. Move to higher ground. Call 132 500 for SES assistance. Visit {help_url} for evacuation centres.

body_template: Flooding is possible at {location}. Water levels may rise from {time}. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: Prepare to evacuate low-lying areas. Avoid floodwater. Call 132 500 for SES assistance. Visit {help_url} for updates.

body_template: A severe storm is approaching {location}. Destructive winds, heavy rainfall, and large hail are expected from {time}. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: Seek shelter immediately. Stay indoors away from windows. Secure loose outdoor items. Call 000 for emergencies. Visit {help_url} for updates.

body_template: A significant earthquake has occurred near {location}. Aftershocks are expected. Building damage may have occurred. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: Drop, Cover, Hold On. Move away from damaged buildings. Check for gas leaks. Call 000 for emergencies. Visit {help_url} for updates.

body_template: A tsunami warning has been issued for {location}. Dangerous waves are expected from {time}. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: MOVE to high ground immediately. Do NOT go to the beach. Stay away from coastal areas. Call 000 for emergencies. Visit {help_url} for safe zones.

body_template: An emergency situation exists at {location}. Conditions may be dangerous from {time}. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: Follow emergency services directions. Prepare to evacuate if directed. Call 000 for emergencies. Visit {help_url} for information.

body_template: It is too late to safely evacuate from {location}. Shelter in the strongest part of your building away from windows. The cyclone core is expected from {time}. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: Stay indoors in the strongest room. Stay away from windows. If your building is damaged, shelter under a sturdy table. Call 000 for life-threatening emergencies.

body_template: It is too late to leave {location}. The fire front is imminent. Shelter in a building, close all windows and doors. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: Go to a room with two exits. Close all doors and windows. Fill sinks with water. Stay low to the ground. Call 000 for life-threatening emergencies.

body_template: Shelter in place is recommended for {location}. Remain indoors until further notice. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: Stay indoors. Close windows and doors. Monitor emergency broadcasts. Call 000 for emergencies.

body_template: The cyclone threat for {location} has passed. It is now safe to leave shelter. Be aware of debris and damaged infrastructure. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: Check your property for damage. Avoid downed power lines. Report damage to SES on 132 500. Visit {help_url} for recovery assistance.

body_template: The bushfire near {location} has been contained. The immediate threat has passed. Remain vigilant for spot fires. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: Check your property for embers and spot fires. Report any fires to 000. Visit {help_url} for recovery information.

body_template: Flood waters at {location} are receding. The immediate flood threat has passed. Do NOT enter floodwater. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: Do NOT drive through floodwater. Report road damage. Call SES on 132 500 for assistance. Visit {help_url} for recovery information.

body_template: The emergency situation at {location} has been resolved. Normal activities may resume. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: Check for damage. Follow any remaining instructions from emergency services. Visit {help_url} for information.

body_template: A cyclone may affect {location} from {time}. Conditions may deteriorate. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: Monitor conditions. Prepare an emergency kit. Secure your property. Listen to ABC Radio for updates. Visit {help_url} for preparation tips.

body_template: A bushfire has been reported near {location}. There is no immediate threat but conditions may change. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: Stay informed. Activate your bushfire survival plan. Monitor fire agencies for updates. Visit {help_url} for information.

body_template: Flooding is possible at {location}. River levels may rise from {time}. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: Monitor river levels. Prepare to move valuables to higher ground. Call SES on 132 500 for sandbags. Visit {help_url} for updates.

body_template: Storms are expected to affect {location} from {time}. Damaging winds and heavy rain are possible. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: Secure loose items. Move vehicles under cover. Stay informed. Visit {help_url} for updates.

body_template: An emergency situation is developing at {location}. Stay informed and prepare to follow directions from emergency services. {severity_detail}.
action_items_template: Monitor emergency broadcasts. Prepare an emergency kit. Follow instructions from emergency services. Visit {help_url} for information.
